retrieval.latency_accounting: The wider recall deadline is benchmark transport margin only; per-row recall_duration_ms remains the measured latency and product-facing Fast SLOs are unchanged.

isolation.unit: one official question per harness invocation
isolation.tenant: fresh packaged-CLI tenant for construction; query-only clones reuse the frozen tenant with a fresh clone-local API key
isolation.scope: fresh server-bound subject, scope, actor, and agent node for construction; query-only clones reuse the exact frozen context
isolation.shared_haystack_reuse: rejected by the adapter's single-question invariant

proof.construction: initialization validates immutable authorization, selection, compiler, provider, cache, subledger, and campaign-journal paths before any worker access; prepare revalidates the unchanged binding, drains once, and derives cache and ledger proof fields from post-worker receipts
proof.query_only: MEMPHANT_LME_PREBUILT_PROOF fails closed on proof, adapter, construction-parameter, binary, trajectory-order, or trajectory-hash drift; query-only performs no retains or worker invocation and emits the construction proof SHA-256
proof.pairing: query fails unless the packaged worker compiles every retained resource exactly once, trace tenant/scope/actor/context/citations exactly match public recall, and the only schema mutation during recall is one retrieval_trace audit row

execution_matrix.pairing: Within every domain/tier cell, Fast, Deep, and no-retrieval must use identical question IDs, reader contract, judge contract, and official 200K context ceiling; all questions must complete without errors.
